key_highlights: ASX suffered a severe $169B weekly wipeout amid heightened recessionary fears and broad-based equity selling.
Mounting criticism of RBA monetary policy as cumulative rate hikes batter household borrowing capacity and accelerate housing downturn.
Consumer discretionary under acute distress with David Jones cutting 1,700 jobs as Myer captures market share.
AUD/USD faces sharp downward momentum, while gold explorers and critical minerals secure capital amidst broader market flight to quality.

sectors.trend: Severe margin pressure from contracting mortgage borrowing capacity, rising bad debt risks from falling property values, and governance headwinds.
sectors.implications: Asset quality risks rising for major banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX); governance scrutiny intensified by NAB underpayment conflicts.

sectors.trend: Bifurcation between gold/critical minerals resilience and macro-sensitive bulk commodities.
sectors.implications: Junior and mid-tier gold producers (e.g., NST.AX, EVN.AX) see strong capital support and project restarts; rare earths breakthroughs offer targeted upside despite broad market drag.

sectors.trend: Consumer retrenchment triggering department store restructuring and GLP-1 drug adoption altering grocery consumption patterns.
sectors.implications: Underperformance in discretionary retail; Myer (MYR.AX) gains share at David Jones' expense, while staples (WOW.AX, COL.AX) face dietary volume shifts.

sectors.trend: Policy friction at COP31 regarding fossil fuel phaseouts, alongside domestic grid vulnerability and Snowy Hydro 2.0 capex scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Heightened regulatory uncertainty for traditional producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); elevated scrutiny on capital expenditure and grid transition reliability.

sectors.trend: AI deployment accelerating white-collar redundancies and offshoring, alongside national security regulatory oversight.
sectors.implications: Productivity gains countered by labor disruption and sovereign security compliance burdens for domestic tech and corporate services.

key_themes: RBA overtightening consequences on domestic demand and property prices
Retail restructuring and consumer spending contraction
Depreciating AUD inflating imported costs while supporting commodity exporters
AI disruption shifting labor markets and driving selective capital raisings
Gold and critical minerals outperforming amidst broader $169B equity selloff

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight residential REITs and mortgage-heavy banks; increase exposure to defensive cash flows.
Short cyclical equities; focus on USD-earning exporters benefited by a weaker AUD.
Avoid debt-laden consumer discretionary retailers; favour market consolidators.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy Grid Instability and Capex Escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Screen energy holdings for project delivery risks and transition policy exposure.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Miners and Proven Explorers
opportunities.rationale: Safe-haven demand, buoyant capital access, and operational restarts buffer broader market declines.
Myer positioned to capture supplier contracts and market share from distressed David Jones.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate USD-Generative Exporters on AUD Weakness
opportunities.rationale: Deep AUD depreciation boosts AUD-denominated earnings and dividend sustainability for global commodity leaders.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Compounding rate hike headwinds, credit contraction, and rapid home price declines threaten loan growth and provisioning.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Benchmark Index Exposure via Derivatives or Cash Allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Recent $169B weekly loss signals institutional risk-off positioning and further downside volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish 1–3 month outlook for ^AXJO as restrictive RBA policy, housing deflation, and weak household demand dampen earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously optimistic 6–12 month outlook contingent on RBA easing pivot, AUD-driven export competitiveness, and stabilization in commodity demand.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board monetary policy meeting and rate decision statement
Quarterly Australian CPI and monthly labor force prints
Black Friday / Christmas holiday retail sales data
National housing credit and CoreLogic home value indices
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate trajectory against key 0.60–0.65 support levels
Banking sector non-performing loan (NPL) ratios and mortgage arrears
Global iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) and gold spot prices
